# ENDLESS: International Journal of Future Studies

> > An international peer-reviewed open-access journal dedicated to future studies research and academic publishing with Creative Commons licensing.

ENDLESS is a scholarly journal focused on future studies and emerging research trends. The journal maintains editorial offices across multiple international locations including Bandung (Indonesia), Las Vegas (USA), Singapore, and Taipei (Taiwan), and is indexed across major academic databases.
